description: Private-key cases for the shape layer. The Go suite (redact_parity_test.go) and the pi extension suite (prism.test.ts) run each input through a redactor with no credential values, and compare the output with want. Thus the two outputs are identical. An input or a want is a list of segments. A segment is a string, or {"repeat": s, "count": n} for n copies of s. All values are synthetic.
